# Per-API-key rate limiting on /v1/*

Type: AFK

## Context

Public API at api.acme.dev/v1/* is unmetered. Need per-API-key rate limit, configurable per plan (free/pro/enterprise) from config/plans.yaml. New middleware sits after auth in /v1/* chain; counters in Redis.

## Acceptance criteria

- Over-minute-limit → 429 + Retry-After.
- Over-day-limit → 429 + JSON body with cap and UTC reset.
- Enterprise bypasses.
- Limits read from config/plans.yaml at startup.
- Admin UI shows current usage per key.
- Unit + integration tests cover under-limit, at-limit, over-limit-minute, over-limit-day, enterprise-bypass.
